Insights

Examples

Example documents you can adapt for your own project. Every example is invented for illustration.

  • Acceptance Test Plan Example

    A worked plan with test cases, roles and sign-off rules that shows how a client checks a web project before approving it.

  • Maintenance SLA Example

    See how a website maintenance agreement defines priorities, response times and exclusions so that both sides can check what was promised.

  • Requirements Specification Example

    A complete, fictional requirements specification for a small booking application that you can adapt section by section for your own project.

  • User Story Example

    Six finished user stories with acceptance criteria for one feature, showing how to write requirements a developer can estimate and you can test.

  • Web Development RFP Example

    A filled-in request for proposal that gets you comparable offers from several web development providers instead of five different guesses.

  • Web Project Brief Example

    A one-page fictional brief with goals, audience, scope, budget frame and timeline that you can rewrite for your own website project.
